generate_text_autoregressive: generate text sequences from a HuggingFace transformer model using greedy decoding or sampling
run_beam_search_generation: run beam search decoding with configurable beam count and early stopping on a generative model
compute_transition_scores: compute per-token transition log-probability scores from generated sequences and beam indices
apply_logits_processors: apply logits processors like temperature, top-k, top-p, and repetition penalty during text generation
assisted_decode_with_model: accelerate text generation using assisted decoding with a smaller assistant model
